no-restricted-globals.name: TextDecoder
no-restricted-globals.message: Hermes has no TextDecoder; use decodeUtf8 from the protocol.

no-restricted-globals.name: TextEncoder
no-restricted-globals.message: Use encodeUtf8 from the protocol, which runs everywhere.

no-restricted-globals.name: btoa
no-restricted-globals.message: Hermes may lack btoa; use encodeBase64Url from the protocol.

no-restricted-globals.name: atob
no-restricted-globals.message: Hermes may lack atob; use decodeBase64Url from the protocol.
